commentary: A behind-the-scenes video of practical effects — **and none of it exists**

credit.name: u/kango888
credit.note: posted to r/aivideo by the creator's own account

caption:
Miniature Manhattan under a tidal wave. A shark rig running on rails. A bridge collapsing on a green-screen stage. Crew standing around with clipboards.

None of it exists. The behind-the-scenes footage *is* the generation.

Worth sitting with, because "show the process" was the last cheap proof that anything was real. Show your desk, show the rig, show the mess on the studio floor — that was how you demonstrated you actually made the thing.

That proof just stopped working. A workspace is as generatable as the shot it supposedly produced.

Which doesn't mean nothing can be trusted. It means trust moves — to the person, the track record, the account that has been showing up for two years. Provenance beats evidence now.

Found at the source rather than three reposts downstream: by u/kango888 on r/aivideo — reddit.com/r/aivideo/comments/1vnlqox
